settings.label: Display mode
settings.help: Play in a window or fill the screen.

settings.label: VSync
settings.help: On shows every frame on a display refresh, so the picture never tears. Off gives the lowest input latency.

settings.label: Lock to display
settings.help: On times the game to your display's refresh when it is a multiple of 60 Hz, so no frame is held or dropped.

settings.label: GPU
settings.help: The graphics card that runs the game. Automatic picks the most capable one.

settings.label: Language
settings.help: The language of the game's menus and text. Only the languages on your disc are offered.

settings.label: Graphics preset
settings.help: Low: Render resolution 720p, Sharpening Off, Texture filtering 2x. Medium: Sharpening Medium, Texture filtering 4x. High: Render resolution 1440p. Ultra: Render resolution 2160p, Sharpening Low, Texture filtering 16x.

settings.label: Renderer
settings.help: Native draws the game directly with Vulkan. Emulated runs the Xbox 360 GPU in emulation: slower, but the reference if Native shows a problem.

settings.label: Sharpening
settings.help: Sharpens the final picture. Native only.

settings.label: Render resolution
settings.help: The resolution the game draws at. The picture is fitted to your window: a resolution above it is filtered down and smooths jagged edges, one below it is scaled up and sharpened. Higher needs a stronger GPU. Native only.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps floors, ropes and crowds sharp at an angle. Native only.

settings.label: Colour
settings.help: Original shows the Xbox 360's colours, richer, with deeper shadows, as in Xenia. Natural is softer, with more detail in dark areas. Native only.

settings.label: 60 fps entrances
settings.help: Runs wrestler entrances and the arena intro at 60 fps instead of the original 30.

settings.label: 120 fps matches
settings.help: Experimental: some moves can look wrong at 120, such as a wrestler briefly out of place on a running throw. Runs offline matches at 120 fps on a 120 Hz or faster display, or with variable refresh. Menus and entrances keep their rates; online matches stay at 60. Needs a strong GPU: lower the render resolution if frames stutter.

settings.label: Mute
settings.help: Silences all game audio.

settings.label: Vibration
settings.help: Enhanced pulses the pad on every hit you take and rumbles harder on finishers and at critical health. Original rumbles only on aerial hits, as on the Xbox 360.

settings.label: Vibration strength
settings.help: Scales every rumble, in every vibration mode. Lower it for a gentler pad.

settings.label: Unlock everything
settings.help: Unlocks every wrestler, arena, attire, Create a Superstar move, entrance and Fantasy Warfare match. Progress you earn while it is on is still saved; turn it off to see only what you have unlocked yourself.

settings.label: Online play
settings.help: Experimental. On signs in to the game server, so the Xbox LIVE menu finds Player Matches. Off contacts no server.

settings.label: Player name
settings.help: The name other players see in the match lobby: 1 to 15 letters, digits and spaces, starting with a letter.

settings.label: Game server
settings.help: Where online play signs in and finds matches. The default is the project's server; type another (a host, host:port or an http(s) URL) to play on a friend's.

settings.label: UPnP
settings.help: Optional: asks your router to open the game's ports while it runs, so players elsewhere can reach you directly. Matches work without it.
